subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.----- TR.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-27, second of two on book p139, paired with v2-p139-1. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what composite focused activism produces when crossed with transformation, in the same context where the spectacle-diversion is operative as the progressional platform. WO-UNF (world unification) branches from the main line and carries C-ACT (composite activism), from whose line HI-P (high purpose) rises and leads to C-HM (composite humanity). EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branches from the main line and carries ECO-DY (economic dynamics) and FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics), which leads to IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). OBS (observation) branches from the main line and carries MT-INFO (multi-information) and AF-POST (affinity postulation), which leads to APL-DT (application dictates) and on to AFI (affinity insight).
